rubric_items.reason: All 13 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-13) are traced by at least one story. The intent has no assumed REQs.
Each story delivers one outcome: tile count, exclusions, period independence, linked list, unchanged dashboard, no personal data.
The ACs are Given/When/Then and cover the boundaries at now, local date vs UTC date and the limit of 10. S-3 AC1 still passes if the tile wrongly filters by the selected period.

The values come from the intent or are worked out correctly from it: Asia/Kolkata gives UTC+05:30, 10 is the upcoming-list limit, and the Last 7 and Last 30 days start dates match the glossary period.
Readable, with consistent terms. The S-4 AC1 body has a note that the front-matter AC does not have.

findings.text: S-3 AC1 cannot catch the likeliest wrong build, a tile that filters by period. An appointment from 1 November falls outside both Today and Last 7 days, so a wrong count stays 0 and the AC passes.

cites.quote: when staff change the period from Today to Last 7 days, then the Awaiting outcome count stays the same
A run of whole hospital-local days ending today

findings.suggested_fix: Use an appointment inside Last 7 days but not Today, e.g. started 15 November, and require the same non-zero count that includes it under both Today and Last 7 days.

findings.text: The S-6 ACs seed only allergies and a phone number. A leak of blood group, medications or other contact fields would still pass. 'Contact details' has no glossary definition, so the fields to check are left open.

cites.quote: has allergies and a phone number recorded
Blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes of one patient.

findings.suggested_fix: Seed every medical history field from the glossary and each contact field the patient record holds, and assert that none of them appears.

findings.text: The S-4 AC1 body has a note that the front-matter AC1 text does not have, so the two copies of the AC differ.

cites.quote: (The tile's own count for this data is covered by S-1 AC2.)

findings.suggested_fix: Remove the note from the body, or add it to the front matter, so the two copies match.

cites.quote: The dashboard has a tile labelled `Awaiting outcome`.
The count does not change with the `period selector`.
showing exactly the appointments it counts (`DSH-8`)
The list of the `next 10 upcoming` appointments is unchanged.
Today, Last 7 days or Last 30 days
Blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes of one patient.
